title: Connect to the Brightpath VPN
body: Open the VPN app, pick the Brightpath office, and sign in with your work account. If the VPN does not connect, restart the app and try again.

title: Printer does not print
body: Check that the printer is on and has paper. Remove stuck jobs from the print queue, then print a test page.

title: Email is not syncing
body: Close the mail app, check that you are online, and sign in again. New mail should arrive within a few minutes.

title: Reset your password
body: Use the self service page to set a new password. The new password must be at least twelve characters long.

title: Laptop will not start
body: Hold the power button for ten seconds, plug in the charger, and wait one minute before you start the laptop again.

title: Headset and microphone problems
body: Pick the headset as the input device in the sound settings, then test the microphone in the meeting app.
